description: Use this before deciding whether a tender is worth pursuing. Pass a tender_id from search_tenders. Returns buyer, description, dates, estimated amount, items, documents, the question deadline and the official source_url, plus agent_guidance: deadlines, questions to ask your user, a checklist of market rules and suggested next calls. If the id is unknown it returns error.code 'not_found': retry with search_tenders using the tender name. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.
name: get_tender_detail
title: Get tender detail
